name: Ortur H20 10W
tagline: Entry H20 chassis with integrated design and Ortur app workflow
tldr: Ortur H20 10W is the base diode tier on the H20 frame — faster traverse than LM3 with a more enclosed integration. Good for engraving and light cuts; step up to 20W or 40W for thicker wood.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Entry H20 chassis with integrated design and Ortur app workflow
Fully enclosed cabinet — beam containment and smoke control vs open-frame diodes
Swappable laser head on the same chassis — upgrade wattage without a new machine
Work area 410 × 275 mm on this chassis
10W on Ortur H20: engraving-first — photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~28–43 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 5 mm basswood class) — not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (20W or 40W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 5 mm+ stock all day
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Ortur H20. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

moduleSystem.headline: Swappable diode & IR modules
moduleSystem.description: H20 ships as a chassis with swappable 10W, 20W, or 40W diode modules and optional 2W IR heads for metal marking — verify which module is in the box.
